tasks.short: Collaborate on economics teaching and research issues

steps.what: Retrieve and check the actual economics course issue, shared research notes and relevant source material
inputs: Colleagues' actual teaching or research question
Current course material and authorized research notes
outputs: Checked context for the collaboration

steps.what: Collaborate with colleagues to resolve the actual teaching or research issue
outputs: Agreed changes and unresolved academic questions

steps.what: Revise the actual shared teaching or research working note and check its complete final wording
inputs: Existing working note and original source material
outputs: Complete checked working note

steps.what: Save the exact checked shared working note
inputs: Exact final note checked in s3
outputs: Saved working note

tasks.design: Use native {LMS} links and {DOCS} shared sections to retrieve current course or research context and revise the actual working note. Keep the collaboration and final academic wording with the economics teacher.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the current source and repeatedly formatting shared revisions adds handling around academic discussion.
tasks.enabler_now: Native links and reusable document sections can remove repeated retrieval and formatting.
tasks.still_hard: Teaching choices, research disagreements and academic commitments require colleagues' judgment.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher evaluates economic arguments and reaches workable academic agreements.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: current-document links and shared sections can reduce retrieval and formatting without resolving academic disagreements.

assumptions: Unmeasured collaboration episode in which an actual shared working note is revised, not an invented report after every conversation. Shares are independent of the prompt prior.

Colleagues supply the actual issue; existing course and research work produces the sources. s1 counts source retrieval and verification; s2 counts the actual discussion; s3 counts actual revision and complete final checking.

No generated research findings, meeting transcript or hidden course publication is assumed. No separate message or notification is bundled into saving. Same-system saving is effectively immediate with no saving.
Existing equivalent links and document sections earn no additional gain. Gross 7.8 minus 2 upkeep gives 5.8 net per 100 focal baseline hours.
research_questions: Which sources are repeatedly located or copied?

already_counted.description: Retained source review and actual final working-note revision and checking

incremental.description: Keep source links and shared sections current

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete working note checked in s3; edits require renewed checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 conditional estimate: 4 retrieval plus 3.8 revision-handling hours = 7.8 gross, minus 2 upkeep = 5.8 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select and obtain economics textbooks and supplies

steps.what: Find current catalogue records, editions, availability and prices for the actual economics course materials
outputs: Checked candidate materials and current purchasing facts

steps.what: Select and obtain the appropriate textbooks or supplies by evaluating content, edition, access and teaching fit
inputs: Actual textbook contents or sample material
outputs: Chosen material, edition, quantity and access requirements

steps.what: Prepare the actual order using native course and supplier fields
inputs: Authorized supplier and course purchasing details
outputs: Complete draft material order

steps.what: Check the complete final order, edition, quantity, price, delivery and actual purchasing authority
inputs: Checked supplier facts and actual delegated authority
outputs: Exact checked final order within authority

steps.what: Send the exact checked material order to the supplier
outputs: Submitted supplier order

steps.what: Check actual delivered materials or access against the order
inputs: Actual received textbooks, supplies or access
outputs: Actual checked receipt and any discrepancies

steps.what: Record and check the actual receipt status and discrepancies in the existing purchasing record
outputs: Complete checked final receipt entry

steps.what: Save the exact checked receipt entry
inputs: Exact receipt entry checked in s7
outputs: Saved actual receipt status

tasks.design: Use native {OTHER} catalogue searches and {PROCUREMENT} fields to reduce repeated material lookup and order entry. The teacher selects actual course materials, checks the final supplier order, inspects the actual receipt and checks the receipt record before each separate send or save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Edition and price retrieval and repeated course purchasing fields add handling to material selection.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing catalogue filters and procurement defaults can reuse verified material and course facts.
tasks.still_hard: Economic content, edition suitability, student access and actual receipt quality need human checking.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher chooses materials that fit the course and verifies what was obtained.

ambition.what: Reduce repeated lookup and entry in current material acquisition.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: catalogue filters and native procurement defaults can reduce repeated retrieval and order-field entry without choosing course materials.

assumptions: Unmeasured delegated purchasing episode including actual receipt; shares are independently sized, not based on the prompt prior.
Publishers and suppliers produce catalogue facts; s1 counts retrieval and verification. s2 counts actual content evaluation and choice. No invented title, edition or price is supplied.

s4 is the actual complete final-order check within delegated authority. Outside that authority, the real purchasing approver must review the final version before submission; this estimate must be rescaled for that actor's work rather than assuming approval free.

s6 and s7 count actual receipt inspection and recording. No complaint email, payment or licence acceptance is silently added. Both immediate send and same-system save are fully retained with no saving; edits void the corresponding gate.
Native capabilities come first; equivalent existing defaults earn no new gain. Gross 9.8 minus 2 upkeep gives 7.8 net per 100 baseline focal hours.
unknowns: Actual purchasing authority and receipt responsibilities
research_questions: Which order fields are still repeated manually?

already_counted.description: Retained lookup, final-order check and actual receipt recording

incremental.description: Maintain course defaults and catalogue links and check changed supplier fields

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete supplier order checked in s4; edits require renewed checking
Exact complete actual receipt entry checked in s7; changed status requires renewed checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 conditional estimate: 6 lookup plus 3.8 order-handling hours = 9.8 gross, minus 2 upkeep = 7.8 net. Selection, receipt and immediate actions remain retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Administer the economics department's working budget

steps.what: Perform administrative duties as department head by collecting and verifying actual budget and commitment records
inputs: Finance's current department ledger and approved budget
outputs: Checked budget and commitment sources with unresolved gaps

steps.what: Compare actual ledger and commitment amounts with the supplied budget categories and ceilings
inputs: Explicit category mappings and approved ceilings
outputs: Draft category totals and exact variance list

steps.what: Investigate actual variances with responsible colleagues and decide the department's working response
outputs: Actual variance explanations and proposed budget responses

steps.what: Write the actual working budget note and check the complete final figures, explanations and decision status
outputs: Complete checked internal working budget note

steps.what: Save the exact checked working budget note
inputs: Exact final note checked in s4
outputs: Saved internal budget note with actual decision status

tasks.design: Configure native {SPREADSHEET} comparisons for the actual checked {ERP} budget and commitment records. The department head investigates variances and completes the actual {DOCS} working note before saving its checked final version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated category matching and budget comparisons consume administrative time.
tasks.enabler_now: Native mappings, formulas and document fields can handle exact comparisons and repeated note fields.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining commitments and deciding which academic activities to support remain department decisions.
tasks.human_edge: The department head weighs teaching and research needs against actual resource constraints.

ambition.what: Revisit the department's working budget when material commitments change.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 for finance and department access consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: spreadsheet category mappings and formulas can compare actual commitments with approved budget ceilings.

assumptions: This is one actual department-budget administration episode, not all department-head duties. Its shares are independent of the prompt prior and cannot be extrapolated without the observed duty mix.

Finance produces ledger and approved budget records; project owners produce actual commitments. s1 counts receipt, reconciliation of source coverage and verification. Missing facts require manual follow-up, not inferred commitments.

s2 is the explicit proposed machine comparison; current equivalent ledger reports or formulas are baseline and earn no extra benefit. s4 retains actual explanation writing and complete final figure checking, saving repeated fields only.

This is an internal working note, not a fund transfer, revised authorized budget, purchase approval or notification. Actual higher approval, where required, occurs on a complete final proposal before those actions. Same-system saving is negligible and has no saving.
Gross 36.9 minus 3 upkeep gives 33.9 net per 100 focal baseline hours.
unknowns: Actual department-head duty mix and delegated budget authority
research_questions: Which variances are already supplied by finance's existing report?

already_counted.description: Retained actual source verification, variance investigation and complete budget-note checking

incremental.description: Maintain budget mappings and note fields and verify changes against finance's source records

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete internal budget note checked in s4; changed figures or explanations require renewed checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 conditional episode estimate: 35 comparison plus 1.9 repeated-field hours = 36.9 gross, minus 3 upkeep = 33.9 net. No estimate for the full department-head role is inferred.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Participate in student recruitment, registration and placement

steps.what: Participate in actual student recruitment discussions about the economics program and student goals
outputs: Student receives actual program discussion and next steps

steps.what: Collect and verify actual registration evidence and prior economics or mathematics coursework
inputs: OPS_SYSTEM: existing student registration and placement system
outputs: Checked registration evidence with gaps marked

steps.what: Match verified coursework codes and completed registration fields to the actual declared prerequisite rules
inputs: Explicit current prerequisite and required-field rules
outputs: Exact matches, missing fields and unmatched qualifications

steps.what: Discuss actual registration exceptions and suitable economics course placement with the student and responsible staff
inputs: Actual delegated registration and placement authority
outputs: Actual case recommendation and resolved or pending registration status

steps.what: Capture the actual registration and placement case entry and check its complete final evidence and status
inputs: Checked evidence and unresolved authority decisions
outputs: Complete checked final case entry with actual pending or resolved status

steps.what: Save the exact checked case entry in the existing student system
inputs: Exact final case entry checked in s5
outputs: Saved actual registration and placement case record

tasks.design: Configure native {OPS_SYSTEM} checks for exact prerequisite codes and registration completeness using actual verified evidence. The teacher retains student conversations, qualification exceptions, academic placement judgment and the complete final case-record check.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeatedly comparing known course codes and required fields adds handling to registration support.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing student-system rules can check declared exact matches without a predictive admission or placement model.
tasks.still_hard: Nonstandard qualifications, student goals and academic placement require authorized people.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher discusses economics preparation and escalates actual authority decisions appropriately.

ambition.what: Reduce exact-match handling within existing student support.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: student-system rules can match verified course codes to declared prerequisites and flag missing registration fields without deciding exceptions.

assumptions: Unmeasured case-support episode spanning actual recruitment discussion, registration review and course-placement advice; shares are independent of the prompt prior. Other recruitment events have a different work mix.

Students supply their actual documents; s2 counts their collection and verification. No free standardized qualifications feed or generated student facts are assumed. Unmatched codes remain manual in s4.

s3 replaces actual manual rule matching only. Existing equivalent student-system checks are baseline and earn no additional saving. No model ranks applicants, decides admission or assigns educational levels.

s5 counts actual required case capture and complete final checking. The record states pending decisions honestly; no hidden formal admission offer, placement letter or external notification is sent. Same-system saving is immediate and earns no saving.
Gross 20 minus 3 upkeep gives 17 net per 100 focal baseline hours.
unknowns: Teacher's actual authority and required case fields
research_questions: Which exact comparisons are still manual and which qualifications need judgment?

already_counted.description: Retained evidence capture, exception discussions and final case-record checking

incremental.description: Maintain prerequisite mappings and test changed registration requirements with the responsible owner

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete case entry and actual decision status checked in s5; changed evidence or status requires renewed checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 conditional episode estimate: 20 exact-match hours removed, minus 3 upkeep = 17 net. No reduction in student discussion, evidence verification or placement judgment is assumed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

Finance and registration owners retain actual source and decision authority.
skills_to_grow: Validate native rule matches against actual records
Check final versions and pending decision status
role.ambitious_version: An economics teacher who spends less time repeating administrative comparisons while retaining academic judgment, student support and actual departmental decisions.
